hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ /94 مَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ /26 عَاصِمِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّجُودِ ، عَنْ /26 زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ ، قَالَ : قُلْتُ : /27 /93 أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ ! يَعْنِي أُبَيَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ
hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Asim ibn Abi al-Najud, from Zirr ibn Hubaysh, he said: I said: O Abu al-Mundhir! (meaning Ubayy ibn Ka'b) - Inform me about Laylat al-Qadr, for Ibn Umm Abd (Ibn Mas'ud) says: Whoever stands (in prayer) the whole year will attain it. He said: May Allah have mercy on Abu Abd al-Rahman, he certainly knew that it is in Ramadan, but he concealed it from people so they would not become complacent. By He who revealed the Book to Muhammad ﷺ, it is indeed in the month of Ramadan, and it is indeed the night of the twenty-seventh. I said: O Abu al-Mundhir! How did you know that? He said: By the sign which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ informed us about - we have seen it and memorized it. By Allah, it is indeed it, without doubt. I said to Zirr: What is the sign? He said: That the sun rises that morning as if it is a basin without rays

hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ /94 الثَّوْرِيِّ ، عَنْ /26 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شُرَيْكٍ ، قَالَ : رَأَيْتُ زِرَّ بْنَ حُبَيْشٍ... (multiple chains)
hadiths.english_translation: From al-Thawri, from Abdullah ibn Shurayк, he said: I saw Zirr ibn Hubaysh when al-Hajjaj stood on the minbar mentioning Laylat al-Qadr, as if he was saying: Some people mention Laylat al-Qadr. Zirr wanted to jump at him but people held him back. Zirr said: It is the night of the twenty-seventh, so whoever catches it, let him perform ghusl, break fast with milk, and let his breaking of fast be at Sahr time. Also: From al-Thawri, from some of his companions, from Aisha, she said: When the last ten nights of Ramadan entered, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would awaken his family and tighten his waist wrapper. Sufyan says: Tightening the waist wrapper means not approaching women. Also: From al-Thawri, from Abu Ishaq, from Hubayrah ibn Yarim, from Ali: That the Prophet ﷺ used to awaken his family in the last ten nights of Ramadan. Also: From Ibn Uyaynah, from Abu Ya'fur, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Aisha, she said: When the last ten nights of Ramadan entered, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would awaken his family, revive his night, and tighten his waist wrapper

hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ /94 الثَّوْرِيِّ ، عَنْ /26 دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ ، عَنِ /26 الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، عَنْ /26 جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ ، /27 عَنْ /93 أَبِي ذَرٍّ
hadiths.english_translation: From al-Thawri, from Dawud ibn Abi Hind, from al-Walid ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Jubayr ibn Nufayr al-Hadrami, from Abu Dharr, he said: We fasted with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Ramadan, and he did not lead us in night prayer for any part of the month until seven nights remained. He led us until about a third of the night passed. Then he did not lead us on the fourth night. He led us on the fifth night until about half the night passed. We said: O Messenger of Allah! If only you had given us the rest of this night of ours! He said: Indeed, when a man prays with the imam until he finishes, the rest of his night is counted for him. Then he did not lead us on the sixth night, and he led us on the seventh. He sent for his family, and people gathered, and he led us until we feared that al-falah would pass us by. I said: What is al-falah? He said: The pre-dawn meal (suhur)

hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ /94 ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، قَالَ : أَخْبَرَنِي /26 دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ ، عَنْ /26 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْنَسَ ، قَالَ : /27 قُلْتُ /93 لأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ /94 الأَسْلَمِيِّ ، عَنْ /26 دَاوُدَ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ ، عَنْ /26 عِكْرِمَةَ ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
hadiths.english_translation: From al-Aslami, from Dawud ibn al-Husayn, from Ikrimah, from Ibn Abbas, Ibn Abbas said: Laylat al-Qadr comes in every Ramadan. And Yazid ibn Abdullah ibn al-Had narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about Laylat al-Qadr. It was said to him: Was it with the prophets, then lifted when they were taken, or is it every year? He said: Rather it is every year, rather it is every year

hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ /94 ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ، قَالَ : حُدِّثْتُ ، أَنَّ شَيْخًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ
